wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/uv/dynamic_callable_sweep.py: """Does calling a builtin THROUGH A VARIABLE answer what calling it directly answers?

Kimi K2.7 raised this as SUSPECTED: `generic_wrapper_is_expressible` only rules out by-reference
parameters and variadic tails, so a builtin under the blanket refusal that carries hidden runtime
state would now be dispatchable and might behave differently through the wrapper.

The way to settle it is not to reason about which builtins have state. It is to call a wide sample
both ways and compare — and to compare against php as well, so a wrapper that is consistently
wrong does not read as consistently right.
